plain_english_policy: Provide tax incentives to small businesses that provide health care to their employees.

effects.rationale: Tax incentives are a form of government intervention in the market by providing financial support for businesses that provide health care to their employees.

Providing tax incentives is an expansionary policy as it increases access to healthcare through employer-provided insurance, which can be seen as expanding the welfare system by ensuring that more individuals have health coverage.

evidence_quote: "Provide tax incentives to small businesses that provide health care to their employees." - Questionnaire Option for Health Issues in Alabama, Year: 1998
